title: MTR and Addons
description: This Modpack is for Fabric 1.20.4. This Modpack add the Minecraft Transit Railway and many add-ons.
body:
## What is this Modpack?

This mod pack is based on Minecraft Transit Railway 4.0 and includes many additional add-ons and utility mods.

## Does this Modpack run without a dedicated graphics card?

Yes. However, performance may slow down as you build more complex setups. The author's computer doesn't have a dedicated graphics card either, but it runs smoothly right after starting.

## What mods have been added?

Let me give you an example.

- Minecraft Transit Railway 4.0.x

- The Tube(the london underground)

- Joban Client Mod

- Station Decoration

- Sodium/Iris

- WorldEdit

Does this modpack include all MTR add-ons?

No.
